name: spanner-graph-schema-best-practices
description: Designs, reviews, and optimizes physical table schemas, indexes, and graph topologies for Spanner Graph on Google Cloud. Use when creating a new Spanner Graph schema, selecting node and edge primary key types, optimizing forward, reverse, or per-node Top-K edge traversals, designing interleaved node or edge tables and covering indexes, configuring cascading deletes and row deletion policies (TTL), evaluating schematized versus schemaless dynamic label graphs, or folding 1:1 and N:1 edges into node tables. Don't use for tuning GQL query syntax or execution plans without schema changes (use spanner-graph-query-tuning), or when creating a zero-change graph overlay on existing relational tables (use spanner-relational-to-graph).
